scenario: LEXP.7.20: a pattern binding read as a value admits no ordering, so `Reading a, Reading b where a < b` is refused with DS_VALIDATE_UNORDERED_TYPE, LEXP.7.19's code, at the `<`. PATH PINNED: the comparison-step check in the validator (Mercury: `dsc.typecheck` `adjacent_mismatches`, `fact_operand`), keyed on an operand typed as a fact reference (`lk_fact`) and on the ordering operator; LEXP.7.19_chain_step_refused already pins the step-by-step walk of a chain.
rules_ds:
schema Reading scope logical:
    id: String key

rule r:
    Reading a
    Reading b where a < b
->
    log info "{a.id}"
